result.markdown:
# Incident Report: Call Setup Failures and Dropped Sessions at S-TUN-013

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-TUN-01`
- **Confidence:** high (The timing of CHG-2026-0056 perfectly matches the onset of KPI degradation; maintenance, external events, and coincident changes were checked and ruled out via T5 and T9.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-22 02:15 to 2026-09-22 07:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-22 02:14
- **Affected:** S-TUN-013, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-005

## Summary

A RAN parameter tuning change template RT-2.4 (CHG-2026-0056) pushed to AGG-TUN-01 caused widespread RRC success rate degradation and increased drop rates at S-TUN-013 and other dependent sites.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose at S-TUN-013 starting at 2026-09-22 02:15, and fully recovered following the rollback change at 2026-09-22 07:32.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-22 02:14: Parameter tuning change CHG-2026-0056 pushed to AGG-TUN-01 [CHG-2026-0056]
- 2026-09-22 02:15: Earliest onset of KPI deviation: rrc_success_pct below baseline and drop_rate_pct spike at S-TUN-013 [T7, ANM-000260, ANM-000261, ALR-0032]
- 2026-09-22 07:32: Rollback change CHG-2026-0057 executed on AGG-TUN-01 [CHG-2026-0057]
- 2026-09-22 07:45: KPIs fully recovered following the rollback [ALM-000482]

## Evidence

- Detector alert and anomaly anomalies recorded on S-TUN-013 for rrc_success_pct and drop_rate_pct starting at 2026-09-22 02:15. [T1, ANM-000260, ANM-000261, ALR-0032]
- Parameter tuning change CHG-2026-0056 was applied to AGG-TUN-01 upstream of S-TUN-013 at 2026-09-22 02:14. [CHG-2026-0056, T2, T6]
- Rollback change CHG-2026-0057 was executed at 2026-09-22 07:32, restoring KPIs. [CHG-2026-0057]
- No external events or scheduled maintenance windows occurred in the region during the incident window. [T5, T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-TUN-01: confirmed. Parameter push CHG-2026-0056 at 02:14 directly preceded the KPI degradation at 02:15, affecting S-TUN-013 and 8 other sites, and rollback CHG-2026-0057 restored normal operations. [CHG-2026-0056, CHG-2026-0057, ALR-0032]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000479: Minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-018 occurred earlier on 2026-09-21 and cleared well before the incident window.
- ALM-000480: Minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-018 occurred earlier on 2026-09-21 and cleared well before the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Review RAN parameter template RT-2.4 admission control and RRC timer settings prior to future aggregation router deployments.

## Sources

- `CHG-2026-0056`: parameter_tuning on AGG-TUN-01 at 2026-09-22 02:14: Push RAN parameter template RT-2.4 to AGG-TUN-01 (admission control, RRC timers) [ROLLED BACK by CHG-2026-0057 at 2026-09-22 07:32]
- `T7`: query_kpis(entity_type=site, entity_ids=['S-TUN-013'], metrics=['rrc_success_pct', 'drop_rate_pct'], start=2026-09-21 16:00, end=2026-09-22 09:31) -> Deviation in 2 of 2 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-22 02:15: S-TUN-013 rrc_success_pct below baseline.
- `ANM-000260`: S-TUN-013 drop_rate_pct spike, z 18.1, baseline 0.62 -> 3.2
- `ANM-000261`: S-TUN-013 rrc_success_pct drop, z -38.7, baseline 99.2 -> 93.7
- `ALR-0032`: ended alert from 2026-09-22 02:15: 9 site(s) (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-005 +5 more); region-level TUN; metrics: drop_rate_pct, rrc_success_pct
- `CHG-2026-0057`: rollback of CHG-2026-0056 on AGG-TUN-01 at 2026-09-22 07:32: Rollback of RT-2.4 on AGG-TUN-01 after KPI regression escalated by NOC
